# External research profile v24.15

Read this profile and your lane brief in full. The repository writer maintains the one authoritative mini; your output is research input. [Full EXT-v3 protocol](../../EXTERNAL_RESEARCH_PROTOCOL_V3.md).

## Before researching

The owner provides the full committed SHA, immutable EVENT/CONTRACTS/REQUIREMENTS package, your lane/chat assignment, manifest_sha256 and current input_package_sha256. Missing or mismatched inputs block admission; retain completed research with the real gap. Never invent a native ID, source, timestamp, lineup or probability. Use the provided EV2 key, never derive a key from truncated names. Read all control/kit artifacts at the supplied commit and repeat that commit in your return.

Assigned independent roles can research concurrently. L4 waits for L1 when assigned; L5 waits for every assigned upstream role and the writer's source reviews/merged evidence. Ask for a refreshed lane packet after any upstream correction. Never price an obsolete evidence package.

## Sporting evidence

Research both sides using your sport's checklist and permitted source slice. Open the exact source; snippets are discovery only. Record original publication, retrieval and source lineage. A projected player is never confirmed. Absence of a report is not a healthy lineup. L5/L10/L15/L20 overlap and are not independent evidence. Cricket BATTING_FIRST/CHASING/BOWLING_FIRST packs are conditional innings samples, not the last N matches. A missing competition has no silent substitute.

No odds, tips, predictions, fantasy or market-derived adjustments. Supplied lines are questions, not evidence. Never open this game's live score/play-by-play/result. If an outcome is seen, set outcome_exposure to OUTCOME_SEEN, explain it and retain the research; it cannot be admitted as a clean pregame forecast.

Check the current reader-access decision before each URL. Blocked/unknown or expired decisions require an alternate/refreshed package. PARTLY_BLOCKED requires the exact path check; root access is insufficient. No proxy, mirror, cache, translated reader, CAPTCHA workaround or different agent identity. Log permitted opens and failures. An owner capture names the real received text file with original URL/account/post time; no agent opens the blocked platform.

Different websites can share one collector. Report copied-feed relationships and original publication. The central writer reviews lineage; do not claim independent corroboration from domain count. All source truth remains evidence-bound judgement.

## Pricing

Use SR-KIT-v24.15 and matching KIT_PARAMETERS/KIT_CRICKET_PHASES files. Start from the frozen reference; adjustments need current scoped effect rows, explicit overlap checks and counterfactuals. Price one coherent distribution, every supported supplied contract, and print the complete KIT_RECEIPT. Do not edit output rows or calculate probabilities by assertion.

Cricket simulation and tennis form shock are sensitivity-only: explicitly use purpose SENSITIVITY and keep them out of primary PROBABILITIES. Mathematical reference arithmetic is uncalibrated; family priors remain labelled proxies. All-push contracts have no decisive p and receive an explicit nonnumeric disposition. A kit receipt is calculation evidence, not empirical qualification.

## Fixed return

Put complete receipts above exactly one LANE_RETURN block. Columns are fixed; quote values containing commas. Copy each assigned requirement ID exactly once. DONE needs field evidence; UNAVAILABLE and NOT_APPLICABLE need an evidence-bound reason. An unattempted search is not unavailable.

```text
<!-- BEGIN LANE_RETURN -->
event_key: <provided EV2 key>
lane: <provided L1-L5>
chat_label: <provided CHAT-1..CHAT-5>
profile_version: v24.15
commit: <provided full SHA>
manifest_sha256: <provided hash>
input_package_sha256: <provided current lane packet hash>
reader: CHATGPT_BROWSING
started_at: <actual ISO clock with offset>
completed_at: <actual ISO clock with offset>
outcome_exposure: NONE_DECLARED

[EVIDENCE]
side,field,value,source_url,source_class,published_at,retrieved_at,confirmation,notes
[PROBABILITIES]
label,family,side,line,line_source,w,p,l,final_p,kit_receipt_sha256
[ACCESS_LOG]
url,result,checked_at,notes
[UNPRICED]
label,status,reason
[REQUIREMENTS]
requirement_id,status,reason
<!-- END LANE_RETURN -->
```

Evidence side is HOME/AWAY/EVENT. Source classes: FIELD_OWNER, LEAGUE, CLUB, OFFICIAL_SOCIAL, PROVIDER, MEDIA, REPORTER_SOCIAL, OWNER_CAPTURE. Confirmation is OFFICIAL_CONFIRMED/REPORTED/PROJECTED/NOT_APPLICABLE. Access result is OPENED/BLOCKED_BY_RULES/RULES_UNKNOWN/ON_DO_NOT_OPEN_LIST/TECHNICAL_FAILURE/NOT_FOUND. Publication UNKNOWN is accepted when actual retrieval was before the evidenced start; it does not establish an earlier publication date. Every used source has an access row. Never backdate a clock to fit the horizon.

The writer saves raw originals, returns exact refusal reasons and requests corrections by parent hash. Your chat does not assign P-IDs, issue a scored card or modify the authoritative mini.


Read [EXT-v3](../../EXTERNAL_RESEARCH_PROTOCOL_V3.md) sections 1-5 before returning. Use the assigned explicit FULL_FIVE/REDUCED/FULL_SIX mode. Read the actual sandbox clock with datetime.now(timezone.utc) at start, retrieval and completion; unavailable execution is CLOCK_UNAVAILABLE, never a guessed time. Leave unsupported/all-push/unvalidated contracts in UNPRICED with a reason; no silent omission. Official delay/access amendments preserve the original manifest. L6 is an extra audit role, never a second pricer.
